claimed_title: Executive Order 5201—Reserving Certain Described Lands for Classification and Pending Advisability to Add to Hovenweep National Monument, Colorado
text:
Executive Order 5201. October 3, 1929
Executive ©rber
COLORADO
Under authority of the act of Congress approved June 25, 1910 (36 Stat. 847),
as amended by the act of August 24, 1912 (37 Stat. 497), it is hereby ordered that
the following described land in Colorado, namely: Lots 5, 6 and 7 Sec. 2, T. 38
432
 
Herbert Hoover, 1929-1933 EO 5202
N., K. 19 W., N.M.P.M., containing 128.01 acres, be and it is hereby temporarily
withdrawn, subject to the provisions and conditions of said acts, for classification
and pending determination as to the advisability of adding sar^e to the Hovenweep
National Monument.
This order shall continue in full force and effect unless and until revoked by
the President or by act of Congress.
HERBERT HOOVER
The White House,
October 8, 1929.
[No. 5201]
